sessionTitle: Responsible AI in Action: From Principles to Real‑World Engineering

announcements.name: Fabric data agents publishable to Microsoft 365 Copilot
announcements.shortDescription: A data agent built on a Fabric ontology/lakehouse can be exposed to Copilot with a single click and queried in natural language alongside other agents
announcements.longDescription: The transcriptWindow only contains the speaker's introduction and framing of a Responsible AI demo, and does not describe this feature in detail. A data agent built on a Fabric ontology/lakehouse can be exposed to Microsoft 365 Copilot and queried in natural language.

announcements.name: Agent ownership and sharing controls
announcements.shortDescription: An agent created in the tenant remains private to its owner until explicitly published to a user or group, giving creators accountability over visibility
announcements.longDescription: The transcriptWindow covers only the speaker's introduction and general remarks about responsible AI principles, without detailing this capability. An agent created in the tenant remains private to its owner until explicitly published to a user or group.

announcements.name: Microsoft Purview for AI agent governance
announcements.shortDescription: Purview (renamed from compliance tooling because it now covers more than compliance) surfaces agent activity, sensitive data, and DSPM views, with AI interaction logs retained for 30 days
announcements.longDescription: The transcriptWindow contains only the speaker's introduction and high-level framing of responsible AI, with no specific detail about Purview. Microsoft Purview provides governance over AI agent activity, sensitive data, and DSPM views.

announcements.name: Azure AI Foundry tracing and monitoring
announcements.shortDescription: Foundry exposes per-interaction tracing, application insights integration, scheduled evaluations, and scheduled red teaming, addressing earlier "black box" feedback
announcements.longDescription: The transcriptWindow only includes the speaker's introduction and a recollection of earlier Build conferences and Azure OpenAI Studio, without describing Foundry tracing in detail. Azure AI Foundry provides per-interaction tracing and monitoring for AI applications.

announcements.name: Guardrails with custom block lists
announcements.shortDescription: Default Microsoft guardrails can be extended with regex-based block lists (e.g., credit card patterns) and attached to an agent to block flagged queries directly
announcements.longDescription: The transcriptWindow contains only the speaker's introduction and general remarks about responsible AI and early agent building, with no detail on guardrails or block lists. Default Microsoft guardrails can be extended with custom block lists attached to an agent.

announcements.name: AI Gateway via API Management
announcements.shortDescription: Models, tools, and agents can be placed behind an API Management gateway to enforce per-user daily and monthly token quotas, securing cost and blocking volumetric attacks
announcements.longDescription: The transcriptWindow only covers the speaker's introduction and reflection on how production agents were once a "black box," without describing the AI Gateway in detail. Models, tools, and agents can be placed behind an API Management gateway to enforce token quotas.
